name: strava
description: Local MCP tools for Strava activities and gear using a private browser session, plus media and route helpers.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update Strava activities and gear through local MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Strava exposes six local MCP tools for activity and gear reads and verified metadata updates. Safari Web Inspector renews the private persistent session when required. Media and route workflows remain available through Python helpers.
capabilities: Date-bounded activity discovery and visibility filtering
List, download, and verified upload of activity photos and videos
Verified activity metadata updates, including bike and start-time privacy
Route creation from start location and target distance
VT1 route scoring from BRouter GeoJSON
Strava route creation and update guidance
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Safari-authenticated Strava workflows when working with my Strava routes.
